headline: ETF After-Hours Update｜Jensen Huang Calls Out, AI Chips Boil! Huaibao Fund STAR Artificial Intelligence ETF Index Rises Up to 4.38%, Six Consecutive Gains! Right-Side Signal Emerging?
summary: A-share markets rebounded strongly on Friday, September 18, with major indices closing higher. The electronics sector attracted net inflows above 29 billion yuan, ranking first among 31 Shenwan industries.
why: A-shares are mainland Chinese stocks listed in Shanghai and Shenzhen, and the Shanghai Composite is the main benchmark. Sector fund flows indicate where domestic investors are concentrating capital.
why_moved: Market panic reportedly subsided, and the electronics sector drew over 29 billion yuan in net main-fund inflows during the session.
